headline: Contested Fronts See Fresh Strategic Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show the principal contested belt still carrying the war, with activity shifting since the previous edition. Palantine Berm is now the liveliest ledger, recording 15 base events in two hours and 47 across the day, while casualties on both sides are accelerating. Weathered Expanse has likewise quickened, with six recent events, 23 daily, and rising casualty rates; its bases stand at five Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral. Nevish Line remains unsettled at 50 daily events, including two in the latest two-hour window, with six Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base. Marban Hollow has quieted in the last two hours but retains five events across six hours and a neutral base amid sharply elevated losses. Callahan’s Passage remains a major grinder, with 26 daily base events and accelerating casualties despite no events in two hours. Stlican Shelf also merits attention: 12 daily events, five in six hours, and a mixed eight-Colonial, one-Warden ledger. Kuura Strand’s earlier upheaval has gone quiet recently, while most other regions report little strategic movement. No victor is recorded.
